# Excalidraw App

This layer contains the main application files for the Excalidraw project, including the main entry point, custom stats, iframe export, Jotai store, constants, bug issue template, collaboration debug, and Sentry configuration.

## Overview

The Excalidraw App layer is the core of the Excalidraw project, responsible for managing the main application files and functionalities.

## Responsibilities

- Manages the main application entry point.
- Implements the Jotai store for state management.
- Defines constants and configuration values.
- Manages bug issue templates for reporting issues.
- Supports collaboration features, including user interactions and room management.

## How it works

The files in this layer work together to provide the core functionality of the Excalidraw application. The main entry point file initializes the application and renders the user interface.

## Configuration

- Environment variables: `VITE_APP_DISABLE_PREVENT_UNLOAD`, `VITE_APP_DISABLE_SENTRY`, `VITE_APP_GIT_SHA`, `VITE_APP_PLUS_APP`, `VITE_APP_PLUS_EXPORT_PUBLIC_KEY`, `VITE_APP_PLUS_LP`, `VITE_APP_WS_SERVER_URL`.
- Configuration files: `.eslintrc.json`, `.npmrc`, `Dockerfile`, `docker-compose.yml`, `excalidraw-app/vite.config.mts`, `tsconfig.json`, `vitest.config.mts`.
